presets library0
usage notesINFO

connecting to speakers / audio system

Phone and laptop speakers reproduce frequencies below ~120 Hz and above ~14 kHz poorly. For serious testing, connect the audio output to a receiver, powered monitors, active speakers, or quality headphones.

For binaural beats, headphones are required — the effect only occurs when the left ear hears one frequency and the right ear a slightly different one.

what's new in v4.0

ADSR — instead of a flat fade, the oscillator has attack, decay, sustain and release like a real synthesiser. Master filter with Q resonance (up to 30) — sweep through it with high Q for "acid" sounds. WAV recording — download anything you run as a 16-bit .wav file. Sleep timer — auto-stop after N minutes. Programmable sessions — define stages with crossfade. Isochronic tones — AM with square LFO, a no-headphones alternative to binaurals. SPL meter + room measurement — use your phone's microphone as a measurement tool.

programmable sessions · how to use

Define a stage (name, frequency, binaural beat, duration, crossfade, level) and press "Add". Stages run in order. Between stages, frequency and level migrate smoothly over the crossfade time — no abrupt jumps.

Two ready-made templates: Meditation (Theta → Alpha → Theta, ~30 min) and Sleep (Alpha → Theta → Delta with a gradual 40-minute frequency descent).

room measurement (mic-based)

With the microphone active and speakers connected, press "Measure room". The app runs a logarithmic sweep and uses the mic to measure the level reaching the room at each frequency. Peaks = resonances (corner buildup). Deep nulls = cancellations from reflections (poor speaker/listener positioning).

The phone microphone is not professionally calibrated — it shows relative trends, not absolute values.

user presets · backup

Save the current configuration (all settings) with a name. Export JSON gives you a file with all your presets — useful for backup or transferring to another device. Import JSON merges them with existing presets (does not overwrite).

hearing safety

Always start with master below 20% and raise gradually. High frequencies (above 4 kHz) at high volume are the most damaging to hearing. Very low frequencies can damage speakers not built for them.

Do not use this application as a medical treatment. For tinnitus, ear pain, or any hearing issue, consult a specialist.

cymatics · simulator chladniSIM
mod (m, n)
raport vs. freq0 Hz
Mathematical simulation Chladni: sin(m·π·x/L)·cos(n·π·y/L) − sin(n·π·x/L)·cos(m·π·y/L) ≈ 0. Nodal lines appear where the function cancels (where sand accumulates on the plate). m,n are modes automat din frequency (mod-uri rezonante aproximative).

advanced modulatorsv4.0
random walk freq
Freq A does a "random walk" — small random steps ±5 cents. SLOW = every 1s, MED = 250ms, FAST = 80ms.

A "sample & hold" LFO generates random held values. Modulates the master filter cutoff. 0 = off, 20 Hz = foarte rapid.

How much the cutoff varies: 0 Hz = inactive, 5000 Hz = wide swing.
